title: Booking confirmation
description: Choose how, when and how often customers are asked before their visit whether they are coming, and what happens without an answer.
forbidden: Viewing confirmation settings needs the settings read permission.
load_failed: Confirmation settings could not be loaded.
addon_off.title: The confirmation add-on is not enabled
addon_off.description: Booking confirmation is available once the confirmation add-on is added to your plan.
readiness.title: These channels cannot send yet: {{channels}}
readiness.description: Requests that cannot go out on these channels move on to the next one. A customer no channel reaches is never cancelled; the booking is flagged.
default.title: Business-wide rule
default.template_hint: You have not saved your own rule yet; the suggested default rule applies.
default.custom_hint: Every branch without its own rule follows this rule.
branches.title: Branch rules
branches.hint: You can save a rule for a branch; branches without one follow the business-wide rule.
reset_default_description: Your business-wide rule is deleted and the suggested default rule applies.
reset_branch_description: The own rule of {{branch}} is deleted; the branch follows the business-wide rule.
on_no_answer.cancel_hint: Without a confirmation by the deadline the booking is cancelled and the time opens up. It is never cancelled if no request could be sent.
on_no_answer.flag_hint: The booking stays and is flagged as expired; the customer can still confirm until the visit starts.
editor.description: A saved rule applies to bookings planned from now on.
editor.branch_follows_default: This branch follows the business-wide rule now; saving gives it its own rule.
editor.enabled_hint: When off, bookings under this rule are not asked to confirm.
editor.fallback: Move on to the next channel
editor.fallback_hint: When a channel cannot send, the next one is tried.
editor.first_request_hint: Bookings made later get the request at once.
editor.follow_up_hint: Without an answer, a second request goes out at this time.
editor.max_attempts_hint: The first one included; extra requests are spread until the deadline.
editor.deadline_hint: No answer is waited for after this time.
editor.window_hint: Requests are not sent outside these hours; they wait for the opening.
validation.deadline_after_first: The deadline must be at least {{minutes}} minutes after the first request.
validation.follow_up_after_first: The follow-up must come after the first request.
validation.follow_up_before_deadline: Leave at least {{minutes}} minutes between the follow-up and the deadline.
validation.needs_follow_up: More than one request needs a follow-up time.
validation.window_too_short: The sending window must be at least {{window}} minutes.
list.title: Confirmation list
list.description: Confirmation requests before visits, customers' answers and the bookings to follow up. The business's approval and the customer's confirmation are shown apart.
list.forbidden: You need permission to view all reservations to see the confirmation list.
list.load_failed: Could not load the confirmation list.
list.empty_description: In branches with the confirmation rule on, every accepted booking gets a confirmation request, listed here.
list.view.label: View
drawer.title: Booking #{{number}} · {{customer}}
drawer.send_failed: The confirmation request could not be delivered on any channel
drawer.send_failed_hint: Call the customer to confirm, or correct their contact details.
phone.title: Phone confirmation · #{{number}}
phone.description: Record it if {{customer}} said on the phone they will come. Pending requests stop and the booking is not cancelled automatically.
phone.note_hint: Optional; shown in the booking history under your name.
phone.note_max: The note can be at most {{max}} characters.
phone.errors.not_open: This booking no longer takes a confirmation; the list was refreshed.
attempts.title: Confirmation requests
attempts.load_failed: Could not load the confirmation requests.
attempts.empty_description: The first request goes out at its planned time.
alerts.title: {{count}} bookings need a follow-up
alerts.description: Get in touch before the visit: customers who asked for a change, did not answer or could not be reached.
nav.info_description: {{count}} upcoming visits are waiting for a confirmation answer.
